ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What would be most impacted by an increase in mussels?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram of a stream ecosystem. On the left, an organism labeled “Mussels” can be seen, and on the right there is an organism labeled “Crayfish”. There are many arrows in the figure indicating influence or feeding relationships in the food web, and there is a connecting line from the Mussels area on the left to the Crayfish area on the right. Reasoning: The question asks “if mussels increase, what will be most affected?” In a food web, changes in quantity usually first affect organisms that are directly connected to, depend on, or feed on that species. Because mussels and crayfish have a direct connection in the figure, the most affected is crayfish.
